title: Pure Gizmek
summary: Pure Gizmek Machine build with generic Links and staples. Every Gizmek is a Machine monster whose ATK equals its DEF, allowing the deck to tutor, excavate, revive, and recover any monster in the lineup while fielding high-Level reactive bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gizmek Naganaki, the Sunrise Signaler tributes 1 Machine whose ATK equals its DEF to Special Summon a lower-Level ATK=DEF Machine from the Deck in Defense Position, and banishes itself from the GY to add 1 of your face-down banished ATK=DEF Machines to your hand.

Sacred Scrolls of the Gizmek Legend excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck once per turn to add 1 ATK=DEF Machine to your hand and banishes the rest face-down, then places a counter every time an ATK=DEF Machine is Normal or Special Summoned—locking non-ATK=DEF monsters on the field out of activating effects once it reaches 10 counters.
Gizmek Makami, the Ferocious Fanged Fortress discards 1 monster on Normal or Special Summon (if you have 6+ banished cards) to search any ATK=DEF Machine except itself.
Gizmek Inaba, the Hopping Hare of Hakuto Special Summons an ATK=DEF Machine from your hand in Defense Position when Normal Summoned.

summary.title: Opening: Sacred Scrolls + Gizmek Naganaki
steps: Activate Sacred Scrolls of the Gizmek Legend and excavate 3 cards, adding an ATK=DEF Gizmek to your hand and banishing the remaining cards face-down.

Normal Summon Gizmek Naganaki, the Sunrise Signaler (or Special Summon Gizmek Arakami, the Hailbringer Hog alongside a Gizmek) and tribute Naganaki to summon Level 1 Gizmek Inaba or Level 3 Gizmek Taniguku from the Deck.

Use Gizmek Taniguku, the Immobile Intellect to stack a key Gizmek on top of your Deck (setting up next turn's Sacred Scrolls excavation) and banish Taniguku from the GY to revive a higher-Level Gizmek in Defense Position.
Banish Naganaki from the GY to recover an ATK=DEF Machine that was banished face-down by Sacred Scrolls or Gizmek Orochi.

summary.title: Face-Down Banish & Level Chain
summary.text: Gizmeks span Levels 1 through 10, so Gizmek Naganaki and Gizmek Arakami (which sends a lower-Level ATK=DEF Machine from Deck to GY to gain ATK) can step down the ladder to dump high-value targets, which Gizmek Taniguku then revives in Defense Position. Cards banished face-down by Sacred Scrolls of the Gizmek Legend or Gizmek Orochi are not lost: Naganaki recovers face-down banished ATK=DEF Machines to the hand, and Makami shuffles 6 of your banished cards back into the Deck when destroyed.

summary.title: High-Level Bosses & Reactive Disruption
points: Gizmek Orochi, the Serpentron Sky Slasher banishes the top 8 cards of your Deck face-down as a Quick Effect on either turn to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY, or banishes 3 cards from your Extra Deck face-down to destroy a face-up monster on the field.

Gizmek Uka, the Festive Fox of Fecundity Special Summons itself from the hand when a monster is Special Summoned from the Main Deck, summons an ATK=DEF monster from your hand or Deck matching an opponent's monster's Attribute, and burns for 300 each time the opponent Normal or Special Summons.

Gizmek Okami, the Dreaded Deluge Dragon Special Summons itself when 2+ monsters are in the Extra Monster Zones and pays 1500 LP to destroy all monsters on the field Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.

Gizmek Kaku, the Supreme Shining Sky Stag Special Summons itself when a monster is in the Extra Monster Zone and equips a face-up monster in the Extra Monster Zone to itself, while Gizmek Yata tributes a Normal Summoned monster to summon itself and grant an extra Normal Summon.
